task.question: Who won GCT Super Rapid and Blitz Poland on May 9, 2026?
task.evidence: May 9 – Hans Niemann won GCT Super Rapid and Blitz Poland with a score of 22½/36. Fabiano Caruana finished second with 22/36, while Wesley So finished third with 21/36.
